notes.title: Game update for the animated scenes.
notes.content: [p]We have fixed the WIN 11 update compatibility issue which caused the red screen during the animated scenes, and the game update is now live.[/p][p]Thanks to all for reporting and hope you will enjoy better the game. [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: About the red overlay screen during the animation
notes.content: [p]We have received reports about this phenomenon, during the animated scenes of the game the screen is covered by something like a red overlay screen. We have investigated and it seems that it is caused by the Windows update KB5064081 Preview.[/p][p]We are working to solve and fix this compatibility issue and will push and update for the game in the next days as soon as we have solved it.[/p][p]For the time being, as a workaround, you need to uninstall that KB5064081 preview update to fix the problem.[/p]
